post.description: Send the full conversation, ending with a user message, and the absolute `workspace_path` selected for this conversation. Supply the same `conversation_id` to continue worker sessions and Leader checkpoints; omit it for an isolated request. `status` events report agent state; `chat_message` contains short team updates; `read_receipt` marks an @mention as read; `activity` describes tool use without arguments; `usage` reports cumulative tokens and each agent's latest prompt context occupancy; `delta` contains the Leader's reply; `done` marks completion. Failures after streaming begins emit `error` with `{message}`.
